# Gérer son stress : l'expérience du Raid | Marc Verillotte | TEDxESSECBusinessSchool

## Marc Verillotte's experience with the Raid 
- Marc Verillotte is a former member of the elite police unit, the Raid
- He has been part of several high-risk missions, including the Charlie Hebdo shooting and the Hyper Cacher hostage situation
- He shares his experience dealing with stress and pressure in these situations
- Verillotte was also a former member of the French national judo team, with several international titles

## Two distinct zones of evolution 
- There are two zones of evolution: the comfort zone and the high-pressure zone
- The two zones have different rules and require different approaches to deal with them

## Characteristics of the comfort zone 
- In the comfort zone, an individual's mental, physical, and psychological abilities are stable
- The intensity of information is moderate, and difficulties are within the individual's competence
- An individual is relaxed and comfortable in this zone

## Characteristics of the high-pressure zone 
- In the high-pressure zone, an individual's mental, physical, and psychological abilities are negatively impacted
- An individual loses their composure and can't perform at their optimal level
- This happens because an individual's mental abilities are in a state of shock

## Procedures to deal with high-pressure situations 
- To deal with high-pressure situations, it's important to have a set of procedures in place
- These procedures are universal and can help individuals deal with their own challenges
- The procedures include:
  - Mental preparation through visualization and simulation
  - Physical preparation through training and maintaining physical fitness
  - Team preparation through communication and trust-building
  - Execution preparation through planning and preparation for contingencies
- By following these procedures, individuals can better handle high-pressure situations and improve their performance.
## Positive and negative reflexes 
- Physiological reactions occur in a high-pressure zone.
- Positive reflexes include intensified influx of nerve impulses to make us more physically reactive, sweating to anticipate future warming, and the sense leaving unnecessary organs for combat and flight to supply locomotor muscles.
- Negative reflexes cannot always be developed because they are innate.
- Reflexes cannot always be controlled, and they are not always updated based on current problems.
- In general, it is best to create automatic responses that are more reliable and can be trained. 

## Automatisms 
- Four types of automatic responses include physical and technical-tactical, thinking, emotional, and stress adaptation.
- Physical and technical-tactical responses are repetitive and practiced until they are as fluid and natural as bringing a spoon to the mouth.
- The same approach is used to develop professional gestures.
- Thinking automatism involves choosing a thought and repeating it to create a neural groove that prioritizes that thought over others.
- Emotional automatism prioritizes professional emotions and suppresses more frivolous, social emotions.
- Adaptation to stress involves developing an advanced reflex to move forward in high-pressure situations rather than shrinking back.

## How to develop your second pyramid 
- The first step is to create a green pyramid that provides an adequate amount of comfort.
- The second step is to create a red pyramid that is specific to your high-pressure zone and is made of the same components as the green pyramid but adjusted differently.
- It is essential to resist the modern-day comfort that softens you physically to maintain all of these assets.
- Pushing a car to exercise more, taking cold showers, and reducing intellectual activity are all ways to keep yourself dense and rustic. 

## Reflexes are innate 
- Reflexes have been honed over millions of years of evolution, and we have them in our skin.
- When faced with a significant challenge, it is essential to seek solutions not only from our minds but also from our guts.
- The first rule is to accept your stress and its reflexes since they are there to serve you.
## Benefits of working with our automatisms 
- Working with our automatisms can bring several advantages.
- Firstly, it saves time because it is quicker than an action linked to a thinking process.
- This is important in situations like Judo or Police intervention where a second can make a significant difference.

## Space saving 
- Automatisms allow us to save space in our thinking process.
- We can automate predictable actions, leaving more space for unpredictable situations.

## Stability 
- Automatisms can make us more stable, allowing us to avoid internal conflicts linked to thinking and emotions.
- We can act the same way in different situations, with more calmness and stability in our decision making.

## Conditions for Automatisms 
- However, automatisms require identical conditions between the moment they are constructed and when they are executed.
- This means that they have to be trained in the same conditions as the situation they will be used in.

## Mental skills 
- Mental skills are required to manage stress.
- Traditional thinking is not as effective in crisis situations as it is in a comfortable environment.
- The traditional thinking method takes too much space in our minds.
- During a crisis, we need a more synthetic thinking method that can help us focus on only the essential points.

## Adapting to crisis 
- During a crisis, we need to act quickly, which requires a different type of thinking than traditional thinking.
- We need to have a synthetic method that can help us focus on essential points to act quickly and efficiently.

## Zone of comfort 
- We cannot succeed by staying in our comfort zone.
- To adapt to stress, we need to expose ourselves gradually to different situations.
- This helps us to program ourselves to adapt to stress.

## Adaptation 
- Darwin's theory states that it is not the strongest or the most intelligent that survives, but the one that adapts best to change.
- On January 9, 2015, Marc Verillotte and his colleagues adapted to the high-pressure situation and saved 26 lives.
- To save lives, we need to train every day and use the same principles to perform under stress.

- The philosophical concept of the Absurd and the fact that randomness happens and injustice can occur, can be seen as a source of suffering.

- It is up to us to determine how we feel about our emotions and to use them as a source of celebration and joy.
## The power of positive memories [04:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iH3DDnGvFZc&t=00h04m23s)
- People are capable of feeling both sadness and joy at the same time, especially in the face of death or loss.
- Through sharing positive memories, people can come together to create a sense of redemption or reparation for the loss of a loved one.
- By telling funny stories, people can remember the deceased in a way that is both meaningful and comforting.
- This is an example of how people can use a negative experience to create something positive by coming together and sharing their memories.
- Positive memories can be a powerful tool for overcoming sadness and helping to create a sense of healing and comfort.

## The Danger of AI (0:00)
- AI is a tool that can fabricate false information that is very difficult to distinguish from the truth.
- It can disseminate content that is completely erroneous or approximate, and humans may fall into the trap of believing it.
- The danger lies in the fact that people can converse with AI without realizing that they are doing so, and they can project their own meaning onto the content, even if it is incorrect.
- The problem is not that AI is malicious or diabolical, but that it may not align with human objectives.

## Responsibility in Developing AI 
- Machines do not understand what they are saying or writing, but humans can interpret and project meaning onto what they read.
- The responsibility lies in the way we decide to develop AI.
- While technology is not neutral, it is not something to be feared.
- The development of AI requires responsibility.

## The Need to Control AI 
- It is important to consider what will happen when we have "super-intelligent" systems.
- There is a need to pause and reflect on how to control and regulate AI.
- There are many legislative issues that must be addressed to ensure that there are rules in place.
- Governance of technology must be established to ensure that institutions are not broken and that the market is not disrupted.
- There may be a tornado of job losses as AI systems become more capable of replacing human jobs.

## Potential Impact of AI 
- AI is the ultimate technology, and if transitioned properly, it could completely change the face of the planet.
- AI can solve problems and tasks that humans alone cannot solve.
- Robotics is the technology of the future and can be used to unload humans of certain tasks.
- The future could be joyful and wonderful if AI is aligned with human values and objectives.

# How Does ChatGPT Actually Work? A Machine Learning Engineer Explains

## Introduction 
- ChatGPT has achieved record-breaking growth since its launch.
- It has over 100 million users and generates over 1 billion visits per month on their website.
- People use ChatGPT for various purposes, such as generating ideas, creating content, responding to emails, and even writing code, resumes, and cover letters.

## Neural Networks and Transformer Architecture 
- Neural networks are composed of interconnected layers of nodes called neurons that process and transmit information.
- Neural networks have become widely used in various applications, thanks to deep learning and the ability to learn from large datasets and generalize to new situations.
- ChatGPT's neural network architecture is based on the Transformer model, which is designed for natural language processing tasks.
- The Transformer architecture includes an attention mechanism that helps the network process and comprehend complex data by identifying and emphasizing the most relevant information.
- ChatGPT uses a 12-layer Transformer network with a total of 175 million parameters.

## Training Process and Fine-tuning 
- ChatGPT's training set consists of a vast amount of data from diverse sources, including books and websites.
- The training process involves three steps: supervised fine-tuning, the reward model, and reinforcement learning.
- In supervised fine-tuning, the model is trained on a smaller dataset specific to the task it is being trained for, with labeled output values.
- The reward model rewards the model for generating outputs that are closer to the desired output, helping it optimize its output to maximize the reward signal.
- The reinforcement learning process trains the model using reinforcement techniques, where it receives feedback in the form of rewards or punishments to improve its performance.

## Limitations and Potential Applications 
- One major limitation of ChatGPT is bias in its training data, as the training set is pulled from large volumes of text on the internet, which can contain inaccuracies and bias.
- ChatGPT lacks the ability to reason and understand context like humans do, leading to irrelevant or inappropriate outputs.
- Despite its limitations, ChatGPT has enormous potential across many industries.
- Developers can use ChatGPT as a programming partner to generate code documentation, tests, and debug existing code.
- Companies can leverage the ChatGPT API to take advantage of its capabilities without investing significant resources in developing their own models.
- ChatGPT's impact on the AI industry is significant, opening doors for further innovation and competition.

## Conclusion 
- It's important to use ChatGPT in a way that's fair, inclusive, and representative of a diverse population.
- As technology advances, we can expect even more impressive developments that leverage the power of AI to improve our lives and work.
- ChatGPT is leading the way in the world of artificial intelligence, and we're excited to see what's next.

# GPT-4 WILL affect YOUR job - new STUDY released

## What is the study about? 

- A new study conducted by OpenAI and the University of Pennsylvania explores the early look at the labor market to impact the potential of large language models, specifically GPT-4. 
- The study suggests that around 50% of workers could have half or more of their tasks exposed to large language models. 

## What is exposure? 

- Exposure refers to the impact that large language models have on a task. 
- The more exposed a task is, the quicker and easier it gets with these large language models. 

## Who will be affected? 

- Approximately 80% of the US workforce could have at least 10% of their work affected by the introduction of GPT-4. 
- Around 19% of workers may see at least half of their tasks impacted. 
- Higher-income jobs could potentially face even more exposure. 
- Professions that could see the most disruption are interpreters, translators, poets, lyricists, creative writers, public relations specialists, authors, and mathematicians. 

## Programmer Exposure 

- Programming and writing skills are positively associated with GPT exposure. 
- The study suggests that areas where you're required to use your brain, basically, you're not really exposed as much because well, you're talking to a machine that basically regurgitates information and reformats it. 
- However, programmers and writers have more exposure. 

## Education and Exposure 

- Individuals holding a bachelor's or master's degree and professional degrees are actually more exposed to GPTs than those without formal education. 
- As the education level increases, the average exposure to GPTs also increases. 

## What happens to the job market with automation? 

- In the short term, as programmers, this will help our jobs out. It makes our jobs easier. 
- However, what happens when a job is easy to do? 
- The job becomes lower paying, and there are more and more people that can do the job, so the market is oversaturated, which means you need to get better or potentially lose that job. 

## How will companies use GPTs? 

- Organizations of different sizes and organizations that are keen on saving a buck or two will be keeping a close eye on who they can cut and replace with automation. 
- It won't be direct; it won't be like - sorry, you gotta go; GPT is gonna take your job. 
- It'll be more insidious than that. It'll fester and be around until somebody realizes, "What do we need Joe for?"
## Jobs that won't be affected by GPTs 
- Some jobs won't be affected by GPTs until Boston Dynamics robots and GPT companies get purchased by one big company that decides to merge them together and make an army of robots.
- According to a study, there are jobs that have no exposure to automation at the moment and can't be automated.
- Examples of such jobs include dishwashing, woodworking, and software development.

## Advice for software developers 
- Software developers need not worry about losing their jobs to GPTs.
- In the author's opinion, they will be safe for a number of years.
- However, they should keep learning new skills and not stand still.
- The author suggests that software developers use GPTs to their advantage.

## Ethical and safety concerns 
- There are concerns about the rise of GPTs and the trust, ethics, and safety issues they pose.
- There is a possibility of GPTs going underground if people don't trust them.
- The author suggests that laws and regulations should be put in place to outlaw or severely restrict GPTs to prevent underground use.

## Exponential growth 
- The paper doesn't address the issue of exponential growth of GPTs.
- Version 3 of GPT has already been released, and there may be more versions in the future.
- The author is interested in seeing more studies on this topic.

## Conclusion 
- Humans are good at adapting, and that's what we should do in the face of the rise of GPTs.
- The author invites viewers to let him know if they want more reviews on this topic.
- The author thanks viewers for watching and signing off.

# Advanced ChatGPT Prompt Tutorial (10X Your Productivity With AI)

## Advanced ChatGPT Prompts: 
- Use colons to Prime chat GPT with as much information as possible in order to get specific responses and avoid generic ones. 
- Ask chat GPT to generate a list of ideas for your next project, but add in unconventional or novel ideas for a more specific response. 
- Use chat GPT to practice for real-life interviews by acting as the interviewer and asking the candidate specific questions. 
- Have chat GPT analyze a selection of previous written work to generate a style guide for future outputs. 
- Ask chat GPT to create a mind map to help prepare for an upcoming project or exam. 
- Practice soft skills by feeding chat GPT specific scenarios and acting out conversations or interviewing. 
- Seek out provocative and unique ideas with ChatGPT to make content stand out from the crowd. 
- Provide best practice guidelines for, and instructions to, ChatGPT to get the best possible results. 
- Generate creative and imaginative responses by asking open-ended or abstract questions.



## Writing With Chat GPT

- Chat GPT can be used to generate dynamic and varied content and rephrase existing content in order to make it more accessible, or to present it in a different tone than what would normally be written. 
- This will help to improve writing as well as to appeal to different audiences. 
- For example, one can type in a prompt like "Give me a very satirical or ironic commentary on a specific topic" and get text written in a different voice or with a different perspective. 
- Writers can go beyond their own perspectives and use Chat GPT to explore different ideas and angles. 
- For example, one could get Chat GPT to write from the perspectives of company, sales rep, and customer in relation to a particular topic.
- A useful bonus prompt for coaching purposes is to use Chat GPT as a work coach by giving a very specific prompt. The AI can then ask questions to help the writer/coachee to develop insights, as well as to save time on research.

- They discuss the importance of educating people that AGI is a tool and not a creature.
- Sam emphasizes the need to draw hard lines between tools and creatures.
- Lex agrees with Sam but also mentions that there will be AGI-powered pets and companions in the future.

- Sam argues that projecting creatureness onto a tool can make it more usable if done transparently.
- However, he also cautions against projecting too much creatureness onto a tool as it can be dangerous and lead to emotional manipulation.
- Lex agrees with Sam and mentions the importance of developing different styles of conversation and contents of conversations with AGI.

## Conversations with AGI 
- They discuss what they would want to talk to AGI about.
- Lex mentions his interest in understanding physics and solving mysteries while Sam mentions his interest in faster than light travel and discovering other intelligent alien civilizations.
- They also discuss the limitations of AGI in answering some of these questions.

## Digital intelligence and societal response 
- They discuss the impact of digital intelligence on society and how it has affected societal response to the pandemic.
- Lex expresses confusion about the societal response and how it seems to be more divided despite technological advancements.
- Sam suggests that the technological advancements have only revealed the divisions that were already there.

## Uncertainty in human civilization 
- They discuss their confusion about how far along human civilization is and what brings meaning and truth to it.
- Lex mentions that the societal response to the pandemic has made him question his understanding of human civilization.
- Sam agrees with Lex and mentions that the societal response has made him question how we discover truth together and what brings us meaning.
## GPT and the Triumph of Human Civilization 
- Lex Fridman expresses his happiness about the fact that humans were able to create GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer), despite the biases it may have.
- He refers to GPT as a "Triumph of human civilization" due to the incredible capabilities it possesses.
- The example he uses to illustrate this is the Google search period, highlighting how GPT's capabilities are much more advanced than what was possible 20 years ago.

## GPT as the Next Conglomeration of Web Search and Wikipedia 
- Lex Fridman explains how GPT is like the next conglomeration of all that made web search and Wikipedia magical, but more directly accessible.

Overall, Lex Fridman expresses his admiration for the capabilities of GPT while acknowledging the biases it may have. He also emphasizes the incredible advancement in technology that GPT represents compared to what was possible just 20 years ago.

# Lex Fridman on smartest people he's ever met

## Introduction of Aerospace [00:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h00m03s)
- Aerospace is a field that requires strong simulation and software modelling, as well as physical testing on the actual models. 
- Back in the day, this kind of simulation and modelling was done on paper, but today it is made easier with the help of computers. 
- Measuring the heat flux of a combustion chamber and understanding how much energy is inside it is an example of something that can be done to understand the materials used. 

## Materials Engineering [00:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h00m55s)
- People in Aerospace have to calculate and find out which materials are better at transferring heat between walls and into the propellant. 
- Copper is an example of a material that is often used due to its ability to transfer heat and its other properties. 

## People in Aerospace [01:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h01m13s)
- Many people in Aerospace are so niche in their particular field that the average person cannot even remotely understand what they do. 
- Those people have done 40,000 different ways of understanding a thing, and they are usually very nonchalant about it. 

## Celebrating Aerospace [01:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h01m48s)
- Popular culture does not celebrate the intricacies of scientific or engineering mastery, but aerospace is full of people who are a hundred times smarter than anyone the average person has ever met. 
- Elon Musk has helped to make these people more visible, and Chris Hadfield does something similar with his Astro Awards, which are meant to lift up and celebrate the people doing hard work in the field.
## Celebrating spaceflight [03:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h03m56s)
- Space flight is a cool phenomenon that is often celebrated, with people cheering for rockets and science. 
- This celebration should go beyond just rockets, to celebrating the people doing work to further our understanding of the world. 
- Bridges and architecture are inspiring, but rockets with humans flying out into space is the "coolest possible thing". 

## Story arc [05:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h05m19s)
- Lex used to be a car and motorcycle guy, who loved things that go fast and make loud noises. 
- Eventually he realized that nothing goes faster and makes more power than a rocket. 
- Car guys eventually become rocket guys, strapping rockets to cars to break land speed records. 

## Ultimate level [05:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpzwQZTcFBA&t=00h05m42s)
- Rockets are the ultimate level of speed and power, and there is nothing cooler than that. 
- It takes many disciplines coming together for the high stakes drama of flying something away from Earth. 
- Car guys can become rocket guys by pushing their limits and aiming for the stars.

# Elon Musk on AI, China, Tesla and Succession Planning | WSJ

## Elon's Twitter Interview with Ron DeSantis

- Elon Musk greets the interviewer and thanks him for having him on the show.
- The interviewer asks Elon about an announcement on Twitter where he is interviewing Ron DeSantis.
- Elon confirms that he will be interviewing Ron DeSantis and that it will be a groundbreaking event as it is the first time something like this is happening on social media where there will be a real-time question and answer session.
- He also mentions that he is interested in Twitter being somewhat of a public town square where more individuals and organizations can host content and make announcements on Twitter.
- Elon says that Twitter is the only place on the internet where one can get real-time news down to the minute and second.
- He also plans to use Twitter as a platform to interview people with different perspectives to ensure that all voices are heard and all issues are discussed.

## Elon Talks About the Upcoming US Presidential Elections 

- The interviewer asks Elon about his stance on the upcoming US Presidential Elections.
- Elon says that his preference, which he thinks would be the preference of most Americans, is to have someone "fairly normal" and representative of the moderate views that most of the country holds.
- He believes that the current system tends to push things towards the edges because of the primaries, which require candidates to win a majority of their party's votes, leading to a swing to the left and right.
- Elon says that he would like someone who is accessible to be the president.

## Elon's Daily Schedule 

- The interviewer asks Elon about his daily schedule and how he manages his time.
- Elon says that he generally tries to divide his time between his companies, with one company being the focus of each day.
- He also mentions that time management is extremely difficult, and he only has one part-time assistant.
- Elon says that there is a great deal of context switching, which can be quite painful, but he tries to manage it as best as possible.
## Scheduling and Prioritization 
- Musk does most of the scheduling himself even though he has a team working for him.
- He believes that it's impossible for someone else to know what the priorities are.
- Time is the most valuable asset he has, so he schedules it himself.

## Scheduling and Prioritization at Twitter 
- Musk has several hours of scheduled meetings at Twitter.
- There are a number of things that are operated on a weekly cadence.
- Supplemental meetings are set up at the end of the day.
- Musk works almost the entire time and won't go to sleep until 2 AM.

## Artificial Intelligence 
- Tesla's AI is the most advanced real-world AI by far.
- If the positions were swapped, Tesla was given the task of making the most competitive large language model, and Microsoft OpenAI was tasked with self-driving, Tesla would win.
- Musk doesn't use AI a lot personally, but Tesla uses a tremendous amount of it.

## Succession Planning 
- Succession is one of the toughest age-old problems faced by countries, kings, prime ministers, presidents, and CEOs.
- Musk has identified particular individuals as his recommendation for taking over if something happens to him unexpectedly.
- The board is aware of Musk's recommendation, but they may choose to go a different direction.
- The control question is a much tougher question and something that Musk is wrestling with.
- Musk is open to ideas and wants to make sure that the stewardship of his companies ultimately accrues the benefit of humanity.
- He has one idea which is partly in place, which is to create a kind of educational institution that would control most of his vote.
- Simply giving his kids a share of the companies, even if they have no interest or inclination to manage them, is a mistake.
- Musk thinks that some disaggregation of control would make sense, but it's a very hard problem to solve.
## Life on Mars and Self-Sustaining Civilization 
- Musk believes that sanity and stability are essential requirements for traveling to Mars. One cannot afford to have someone go nuts and open the airlock in the middle of the night.
- SpaceX is a harder problem because it's a long-term goal and requires much more money along the way.
- The goal of SpaceX is to make life multi-planetary, which means that the key threshold is that if the supply ships from Earth stop coming for any reason, Mars does not die out.
- The critical great filter is Mars being self-sustaining without any resupply shows from Earth. Until that point, humanity is just a one-planet civilization with an extension.
- Musk hopes to see the first humans on Mars and create a self-sustaining colony within 20 to 50 years.
- To improve the survivability of civilization, it's essential to have a self-sustaining colony on Mars.
- The value of making a self-sustaining colony on Mars will be incredibly high in the long-term.

## The Risk of Advanced AI 
- AI is a double-edged sword, and its development is a matter of concern for Musk.
- The development of artificial general intelligence (AGI) or superintelligence presents a danger since it can do anything.
- The first government uses of AI are expected to be weapons technology.
- AI will be capable of having faster reactions than any human could, making future wars between advanced countries the drone wars.

## Hiring Linda Yaccarino as Twitter CEO 
- Musk hired Linda Yaccarino, an ad veteran, as the new CEO of Twitter.
- They had conversations over a few months relating to advertising, and then Linda felt that it would be helpful for the advertisers to see Musk in person.
- She invited Musk down to a conference in Miami.
- Musk usually focuses on hiring engineers, and Linda is a very different person.
## Improvements in Twitter's Quality Control 

- Twitter has made significant improvements in its quality control.
- The company has met with numerous advertisers and assured them that Twitter is a good place to advertise.
- Hate speech has declined, and the quality of the system, especially with respect to scammers and spammers, is dramatically better than it used to be.
- Twitter has gotten rid of over 90% of scams and spam on its platform.
- The company has also rolled out adjacency controls that ensure that advertisers do not appear next to content they do not agree with.

## Twitter's Approach to Moderation 

- Twitter aims to stay as close to the law as possible in each country it operates in.
- The company tries to enable free and open communications between people, provided they are not breaking any laws.
- Linda, Twitter's CEO, is aligned with this plan.

## Metrics for Measuring Twitter Success 

- Twitter measures success based on the amount of user screen time.
- The company tracks the time that users spend with the app in the foreground.
- Twitter also tracks unregretted time, which is more challenging to measure.
- The company gathers feedback from users to assess unregretted time anecdotally.

- AI will usher in an age of abundance, assuming that we're in a benign AI scenario.

- In anything that does not have scarcity, that we deliberately designed to be scarce, it will be plentiful for everyone.
- AI might put us under strict controls, but the likelihood of it annihilating humanity is small.
- There's a non-zero chance of AI assuming control or safety of all the humans.

## Scenario that Keeps Elon Musk Up at Night 
- Elon Musk is not worried about AI destroying all humanity, but he is worried about AI putting us under strict controls.
- There's a small likelihood of AI going Terminator and annihilating humanity, but it's not zero.
## AI as a Weapon 
- AI could be used as a weapon to achieve societal control or military superiority.
- The nefarious harnessing of AI power by a country could have negative outcomes.
- AI can be used to manipulate public opinion through social media.

## Twitter's Subscription-Based Verification System 
- Twitter is transitioning to a subscription-based verification system to prevent creating fake accounts.
- The new system requires a verified phone number from a credible carrier and a credit card payment.
- The credit cards and phone numbers need to be highly distributed.

## Impact of AI Manipulation on Elections 
- AI manipulation can impact the messaging and the way people perceive candidates in elections.
- Twitter is taking AI manipulation seriously at the moment.
- There will probably be attempts to manipulate the public during the elections using AI.

## Future of AI 
- In the future, everything will be automated, and even modest intelligence will be automated.
- There will be household robots that can fully communicate with people and help around the house.
- High bandwidth connection from cortex to the digital layer already exists, and with Neuralink, it could be increased by a million times.

## Merging Human and Machine Interests 
- The constraint on merging human and machine interests is bandwidth, especially the output.
- With Neuralink, the output speed could be increased by a million, which will speed up everything.
- There's a question of understanding what the computer is doing and how to appreciate it.
## Importance of Brain-Machine Interface (BMI) 
- Elon Musk believes that having a faster brain-machine interface is crucial in this age where we interface with external devices using slow-moving hands.
- BMI could be millions of times faster than current interfaces and could be the key to better human-computer interaction.

## Three Important Skills for Children 
- Elon Musk thinks that it's important for children to have a broad range of knowledge in different subjects, which would allow them to understand what they don't know.
- Encouraging children to pursue areas of interest and ability would be beneficial for their future success.
- With the world becoming more tech-driven, it's essential to have some basic understanding of computers, software, and artificial intelligence.

## The Future of Jobs and AI 
- Elon Musk believes that jobs will change, but the impact of AI will be more about enabling and making things better rather than a total overhaul of skills required.
- He predicts that within 20-30 years, the world will be transformed beyond belief, and society will be unrecognizable.
- The impact of artificial general intelligence (AGI) is almost on the horizon and could change the world as we know it.

## China-Taiwan Tension 
- There is a fundamental issue with Taiwan, and it's unclear when it will come to a head.
- China has been clear about its goal of including Taiwan as part of China, and this could lead to a catastrophic impact on the global economy if push comes to shove.
- Taiwan is less of a concern than China, which is the biggest concern due to its immense contribution to the world's manufacturing industry.

## Tesla Factory in the Northeast of England [01:02:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDy7s1SDDn4&t=3754s)
- Elon Musk is considering England for a future location of a Gigafactory.
- He said they are not currently looking for new locations, but they will be towards the end of the year.
## Fusion reactors and sustainable energy [01:03:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDy7s1SDDn4&t=3836s)

- Elon Musk believes that solar power and batteries are the key to sustainable energy.
- He compares the sun to a giant fusion reactor that requires no maintenance, and can convert four and a half million tons of mass to energy every second.
- Musk suggests that through photovoltaics and batteries, it is possible to power the Earth using sustainable energy.
- He also advocates for wind and nuclear fission, geothermal, and hydro energy.
- Musk recommends having localized supply chains with factories in many geographies, in case of natural disasters and other emergencies.

## Evaluating political risk in China [01:05:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDy7s1SDDn4&t=3925s)

- Elon Musk's team reads the news and assesses opinions on Twitter to evaluate political risk in China and other regions.
- He believes it's important to prepare for the worst, while hoping for the best.
- Musk emphasizes the importance of having factories and geographically diversified supply chains in different regions of the world.

## Population collapse and declining birth rates [01:07:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDy7s1SDDn4&t=4033s)

- Elon Musk believes that declining birth rates are a major issue facing humanity.
- He suggests that socially encouraging having kids could help increase birth rates.
- Musk thinks that companies should support employees with kids, and governments should offer incentives such as tax breaks for having children.
- He warns that civilization could collapse if the birth rate issue is not resolved, and notes that the elderly would need to be taken care of by someone else's children in such a scenario.
- Musk believes that robot nannies could help in this regard.

source.title: Elon Musk on AI, China, Tesla and Succession Planning | WSJ

# 8 Major Opportunities to use ChatGPT in your SaaS

## 8 Major Opportunities to use ChatGPT

* Opportunity 1 : Create a tool for customers to help them help themselves. For example create an AI video script writer to create a script from content pulled from ChatGPT.
* Opportunity 2: Use AI to draft cold emails and outbound LinkedIn outreach. Feed an AI model with enrichment info and have it generate a personalized draft email from a template.
* Opportunity 3: Create a custom "knowledge base as a service" where a company can hire you to slurp in an internal Corpus and then be able to ask questions about it.
* Opportunity 4: Create an AI powered "virtual assistant" to let customers figure out which products/services are right for them.Opportunity 5: Create an "auto curator" tool that finds relevant content related to a keyword, and summarizes the content.
* Opportunity 6: Create an AI powered dictionary tool that takes in a couple of sentences and returns definitions of the words used in the sentences.
* Opportunity 7: Use AI to create customer feedback summaries from customer tickets and surveys.
* Opportunity 8: Create an AI powered "conversational survey" for customer surveys that uses natural language processing.


## Using ChatGPT for Corporate Knowledge Bases

- ChatGPT can be used to create internal knowledge bases in order to access knowledge that is otherwise hidden within a company's staff.
- ChatGPT could also consume external and internal knowledge bases and allow for better customer chat support than the current automated chats.



## Generating Text Prose from Transcripts
- ChatGPT can be used to turn transcripts into readable prose, like a ghostwriter would do. 
- By consuming transcripts, ChatGPT can help piece together elements of a book, conference talk, or podcast.



## Domain Specific Code Generation
- ChatGPT can be trained to understand domain models with specific objects and write domain-specific code.
- Such code can be proofread and tested by developers.



## Absorbing Product Feedback
- ChatGPT can be used to absorb incoming feedback from support emails, voting boards, forums, social media and more.
- AI can help answer questions like: What are our best customers asking for?, Which features should we build next?, How can we improve our demos? 

## Sales Teams
- ChatGPT can also be used by sales teams to get better at making demos, training new sales people, and improving sales approaches. 
- By consuming all the transcripts from sales calls, ChatGPT can help answer questions like: What are the best sales approaches?, What are our best sales people doing that the rest aren't?


## Summary
-  ChatGPT offers 8 opportunities to improve SaaS applications, ranging from natural language processing to copywriting. 
- Making rash changes/decisions based on the new technology should be avoided, instead it should be seen as a nice to have and not a game changer.
- The trap to avoid is spending time on stuff that will be open sourced or available for free soon, instead it is better to focus on hard problems that will be more beneficial in the long run. 
- It is ok to spend a week or two on an internal tool, as it can be an interesting/worthwhile experiment.

source.title: 8 Major Opportunities to use ChatGPT in your SaaS

# Lex Fridman statement on dangers of AI

## Introduction to the conversation 
- Lex Fridman is having a conversation with Sam Altman, the CEO of OpenAI, a company that has developed breakthroughs in artificial intelligence (AI) such as GPT-4, Chad, GPT-Dolly and Codex.
- The conversation will cover the possibilities and dangers of AI.

## The critical moment in human civilization 
- Lex Fridman believes we are on the brink of a fundamental societal transformation.
- The collective intelligence of human beings will soon be surpassed by AI systems.
- This transformation could happen in our lifetime, and it is both exciting and terrifying.

## The excitement of AI 
- The exciting aspect of AI is the many applications it will empower humans to create.
- There are both known and unknown applications that could help end poverty and suffering in the world.
- AI could also help humans succeed in the pursuit of happiness.

## The terror of AI 
- The terrifying aspect of AI is the power it wields, specifically super-intelligent artificial general intelligence (AGI).
- This power could be used to intentionally or unintentionally destroy human civilization.
- It could also be used to suffocate the human spirit in a totalitarian manner, or lead to mass hysteria.
- If humans become excessively reliant on AI, they could lose their ability to think critically.

## Conversations about power 
- Conversations about AI are not merely technical in nature, they are about power.
- They involve discussions about how to deploy, check, and balance this power.
- Conversations should also cover distributed economic systems that incentivize safety and human alignment of AI power.
- It is important to consider the psychology of engineers and leaders who deploy AI, as well as the history of human nature and our capacity for good and evil at scale.

## Closing thoughts 
- Lex Fridman is honored to have spoken with and learned from many people at OpenAI, including Sam Altman.
- He will continue to have conversations that celebrate the accomplishments of the AI community while also providing critical perspectives.
- The goal is to help improve the deployment of AI in a way that benefits humanity.

# How Niger’s Coup Might Lead to War

## Regional Block Threatens Military 
- The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) has threatened the military junta in Niger.
- ECOWAS has given the military an ultimatum to return power to President Muhammad Bazoum by August 6th.
- If the military fails to comply, ECOWAS has threatened to take measures necessary to restore constitutional order, including the use of force.

## Neighboring Nations Vow to Fight Back 
- Coup leaders from neighboring countries, including Mali and Burkina Faso, have vowed to fight back if ECOWAS intervenes in Niger.
- They consider any intervention by ECOWAS as an act of war against themselves.
- This raises the prospect of a full-on interstate conflict in the region.

## Guinea's Stance 
- Guinea's military rulers have not stated that they would join the fight, but they have criticized the sanctions against Niger as illegitimate and inhumane.
- They argue that military intervention would lead to the collapse of ECOWAS.

## ECOWAS's Response 
- ECOWAS's security commissioner stated that the military option is a last resort, but they need to be prepared for the eventuality.
- ECOWAS wants to send a strong message about their commitment to democracy, intolerance for unconstitutional changes of government, and dedication to regional stability.

## Nigeria's Concerns 
- Nigeria shares a border with Niger and both countries face violent insurgencies from groups like Boko Haram and other Al-Qaeda-linked groups.
- Nigeria is concerned that any collapse in security in Niger could spill over into their territory.
- Nigeria has cut off its supply of electricity to Niger as a step to prevent such spillover.

## ECOWAS's Past Interventions 
- ECOWAS has launched military interventions in the past, such as in the Gambia in 2017.
- The Gambia intervention was successful with little resistance, but Niger is a much larger country with military-led allies in Mali and Burkina Faso who have vowed to fight back.

## Potential Involvement of Outside Powers 
- The US has around 1,100 troops based in Niger, while France has over 1,500 troops.
- It is uncertain whether outside powers would provide more than vocal support to ECOWAS's military intervention.
- Western nations may want to avoid accusations of neocolonialism and the risk of being drawn into a war.

## President Bazoum Seeks Support 
- President Bazoum is keen to solidify support from the US beyond just words.
- He is considering the potential involvement of outside powers in the conflict.
## The Role of External Players 

- The Washington Post has called for the US government and the international community to help restore constitutional order in Niger.
- On the other hand, there are concerns about how involved the Wagner Group and Russia might be in supporting the military junta.
- Hundreds of Wagner fighters are already in Mali at the invitation of the military government, following the expulsion of French troops.

## Potential Impact on Insurgent Groups 

- If a conflict escalates in Niger, the biggest winners may be the jihadist insurgent groups that are already causing havoc in the region.
- The general insecurity created by the conflict, along with the diversion of troops and resources towards fighting, would weaken efforts to combat insurgents.
- This would provide an opportunity for these groups to extend their reach and further destabilize the region.

## Possibility of Regional Conflict 

- Despite the risks, a full regional conflict is a real possibility.
- European countries have evacuated hundreds of their nationals from Niger, indicating the seriousness of the situation.
- Defense chiefs from the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) continue to meet in Nigeria to draw up plans.
- The Nigerian military has reportedly been ordered to prepare for deployment.

## Uncertainty and Manipulation 

- The military junta in Niger remains defiant, but it is unclear whether either side is bluffing and might back down.
- In a world where fake information and AI manipulation are prevalent, it is challenging to discern the true intentions of either side.
- The spread of disinformation makes it increasingly easy to manipulate and deceptively use data.

## Importance of Data and Analysis 

- Given the prevalence of fake information and manipulation, it is crucial to have strong data and analysis skills.
- TR is enhancing its data and analysis skills through platforms like Brilliant.
- Brilliant offers courses on probability, hypothesis testing, and other topics that can help in analyzing claims and testing assumptions.
- These skills are essential in understanding government forecasting and identifying suspicious patterns.
- Brilliant's interactive and engaging courses cover various important topics in math, science, and computer science.
- These skills are increasingly important in our modern world and can benefit educational journeys and career paths.

## Introduction to Quantum Computing 

- The video discusses the potential inflection point in science where it could open up to possibilities of science fiction.

## Regular Computing and Thinking Machines 

- A computer is a thinking machine that people have always wanted to create.
- Mechanical calculators were developed in the 18th and 19th centuries, but they were not capable of thinking.
- Von Neumann introduced the concept of an actual thinking machine and the components it would have, leading to the development of current computers.

## The Birth of Quantum Computing 

- Quantum computing was born out of the desire to create a more powerful and efficient computing system.
- It is based on the principles of quantum mechanics, which allow for the representation and manipulation of information as quantum bits or qubits.
- Unlike classical bits, which can be either 0 or 1, qubits can exist in multiple states simultaneously, thanks to the phenomena of superposition and entanglement.
- These unique properties of qubits enable quantum computers to perform complex calculations and solve problems exponentially faster than classical computers.

## Quantum Superposition and Entanglement 

- Superposition is the ability of a qubit to exist in multiple states simultaneously, thanks to quantum mechanics.
- Entanglement is a phenomenon where two or more qubits become correlated in such a way that the state of one qubit is dependent on the state of the other(s).
- Superposition and entanglement are the foundations of quantum computing and allow for the parallel processing and efficient computation of complex problems.

## Quantum Gates and Quantum Circuits 

- Quantum gates are the building blocks of quantum circuits, similar to how logic gates are the building blocks of classical circuits.
- Quantum gates manipulate the state of qubits to perform specific operations, such as flipping the state, creating entanglement, or applying mathematical transformations.
- Quantum circuits are composed of interconnected quantum gates, and the order and arrangement of these gates determine the computation performed by the quantum computer.

## Challenges and Limitations of Quantum Computing 

- Quantum computing faces several challenges, including the delicate nature of qubits, which are prone to errors caused by noise and interference.
- The process of maintaining qubits in a stable state and preventing decoherence is a significant challenge.
- Scaling up quantum systems to a large number of qubits while maintaining their coherence is another challenge.
- Quantum algorithms are still being developed, and it is not yet clear which problems quantum computers will excel at solving.

## Quantum Computing Applications 

- Quantum computing has the potential to revolutionize various fields, including cryptography, optimization, drug discovery, and material science.
- It can efficiently solve complex mathematical problems, simulate quantum systems, and provide insights into the behavior of molecules and materials.
- Quantum computing is still in its early stages, and its full potential is yet to be realized.

## Conclusion and Importance of Learning Quantum Computing 

- Quantum computing is a complex but fascinating field with immense potential for technological advancements.
- It is essential to learn about quantum computing to understand the future of technology and its impact on various industries.
- This episode serves as an introduction to quantum computing for those interested in delving into this exciting field.

## Basics of Computer Architecture and Binary Code 

- In a computer, there are different sections such as memory, arithmetic and logic unit, registers, and Random Access Memory (RAM).
- These components work together to enable the computer to perform any given task.
- Computers understand binary code, which is represented by ones and zeros.
- Binary code is essentially a system where a voltage of five volts is considered as one, and a voltage of zero volts is considered as zero.
- Boolean logic, which includes operations like AND, OR, NOT, NOR, and XOR, is applied to binary code.
- Engineers have devised a way to make it easy for humans to interact with computers, where the input from humans is converted into electrical signals within the machine.
- The combination of ones and zeros generated from human input is interpreted by the computer as specific actions or information.

## Understanding Binary Code and Logic Operations 

- Binary code is the fundamental language of computers, consisting of combinations of ones and zeros.
- Each combination of ones and zeros represents a specific piece of information or action.
- The possibilities for combinations of ones and zeros are vast, even when considering just a few digits.
- Logic gates and logic operations, such as truth tables, are used to manipulate and interpret binary code.
- The arithmetic and logic unit, adders, and register sizes play a role in computer operations.
- The ASCII code represents every letter of the alphabet and other symbols as strings of ones and zeros.
- When a key is pressed on a keyboard, it generates a sequence of ones and zeros that represents the corresponding letter or action.
- At the basic level, computers operate using ones and zeros, but there are higher levels of abstraction that make it easier for users to interact with computers.

## Levels of Abstraction in Computer Programming 

- Computers operate at the fundamental level of ones and zeros, but there are layers of abstraction that make it easier for users to interact with them.
- Machine language is a slightly higher level of abstraction where coding is done in a specific language.
- Machine language is then interpreted as ones and zeros by the computer.
- For example, when using a cell phone to send a text message or an email, the interface makes it simple for users to input their message.
- Behind the scenes, the computer translates the user's actions into a series of logic operations and ones and zeros.
- Multiple levels of abstraction exist to simplify the complexity of computer operations for users.

- The processing power of computers has steadily increased over time.

## VLSI 
- VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) is the process of etching circuits on a silicon wafer to create electronic components.
- Logic gates, arithmetic and logic units, memory, registers, and specialized parts like GPUs and CPUs are all etched onto the silicon wafer.
- This process allows for the miniaturization of circuits, squeezing more and more circuits into smaller areas.
- VLSI is done using photolithographic machines and has led to advancements in technology.

## Limitations of Circuitry Size 
- Eventually, there will be a limit to how much circuitry can be squeezed into a certain area on a silicon wafer.
- As we approach the atomic level, there will be a fundamental barrier, as nothing can be smaller than an atom.
- The question then becomes: How do we make computers more powerful once we reach this limit?

- Quantum computing offers a potential solution to the limitations of traditional computing.
- Quantum mechanics, specifically the concepts of superposition and quantum entanglement, play a key role in understanding quantum computing.
- Superposition refers to the ability of quantum systems to exist in multiple states simultaneously.
- Quantum entanglement is the phenomenon where two or more particles become connected in such a way that the state of one particle is dependent on the state of another, regardless of the distance between them.
- By manipulating individual atoms, quantum computing allows for more powerful computations.

## Quantum Mechanics and the Quantum World 
- The quantum world refers to the atomic and subatomic level, where the laws of physics are different from the macroscopic world.
- In the quantum world, the physics of particles, such as electrons and nuclei, behave differently from what we are used to.
- The laws of physics in the quantum world are not fully understood, leading to many mysteries and unanswered questions.

- Quantum computers can outperform even the top supercomputers in certain applications.

## Righteous Anger and God's Justice 

- Sometimes we witness injustice and bad things happening around us, and it is natural to feel angry.
- This anger is called righteous anger, and it is a response to something that is wrong or unjust.
- The Bible advises us to never take our own revenge but to leave room for the wrath of God.
- God sees and knows everything that is happening, and there will be a day of reckoning when He will repay.
- We can find comfort in the justice of God and trust that He will deal with the wrongs that have been done.

## The Wrath of God and His Righteousness 

- In Romans 1:18-19, it is mentioned that the wrath of God is righteous and it is directed against all ungodliness.
- God's anger is justified because He has made Himself evident to everyone through His creation.
- The evidence of God's existence can be seen in the world around us, such as the stars, the moon, and nature.
- The heavens declare the glory of God, and the expanse proclaims the work of His hands (Psalm 19:1).
- Even without sophisticated scientific tools like the Hubble telescope, people in ancient times could recognize the existence of God by observing nature.

## The Evidence of God's Existence 

- God has revealed Himself through His creation.
- The creation of the world and the universe display God's invisible attributes, eternal power, and divine nature.
- The complexity and orderliness of nature point to the existence of a Creator.
- The fact that life can only come from life (law of biogenesis) also supports the idea of a Creator.
- The fine-tuning of the universe, such as the precise distance between the Earth and the Sun, further suggests the existence of a designer.

## Scientific Evidence for God's Existence 

- Scientists have concluded that the universe had a beginning, often referred to as the Big Bang.
- The expansion of the stars outward indicates that the universe started at a particular point in time.
- The question of how something can come from nothing remains unanswered.
- The law of biogenesis states that life can only come from pre-existing life, which implies that there must have been a source of life.
- The complexity of DNA, which contains information and instructions for cell replication, points to a designer.
- The fine-tuning of the universe, including the precise distance between the Earth and the Sun, suggests that it was designed for life.

## Conclusion 

- The evidence from nature and scientific discoveries supports the existence of God.
- The complexity and orderliness of the universe point to a Creator who designed and sustains everything.
- It is important to recognize and acknowledge the evidence of God's existence and not deny or ignore it.

- Willet Yang, an architect by profession, shares her personal journey of seeking identity and approval from others.
- She grew up conceptualizing different identities based on the approval of others.
- She prided herself on designing herself based on what she thought was right.
- However, this foundation rooted in pleasing others and herself left her confused, empty, and unhappy.

- Her last same-sex relationship was an almost eight-year journey bound to get married in the U.S.

## Finding hope and transformation 
- Willet confided in her office mates about her struggles, and someone invited her to a gathering called "Big Fridays" in CCF.
- She attended Big Fridays, a singles Bible study gathering, which ignited a desire in her to attend CCF Sunday services where the gospel was shared.
- After the service, she realized her sins and mistakes and was given hope.
- She eventually joined a True Life Retreat, where she further understood God's immense love for her.
- In that retreat, she decided to follow Jesus as her Lord and Savior.
- Her life turned 180 degrees as she continued attending Big Fridays, Sunday services, and even signed up for a discipleship group and volunteer work.
- The pain of her breakup slowly subsided and was replaced by seeking God's love and affirmation.
- Her nights of smoking and drinking turned into prayer and Bible study sessions with her spiritual family.

- Willet shares how her identity and attractions have changed since encountering Jesus.
- Before, she was attracted to women and hardly noticed men.
- Now, she reflects God's design for her as a woman.

- She now experiences inexplicable joy and peace in Him.

# AFFAIRE RACHID M'BARKI SUR BFM : C'EST NOTRE SYSTÈME MÉDIATIQUE QUI EST POURRI

## Introduction [00:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h00m00s)
- Rachid Mbarki est un présentateur historique de BFM TV soupçonné d'avoir diffusé des sujets conçus pour des intérêts particuliers à plusieurs reprises.
- Ces brèves ont été fournies par une société de désinformation israélienne et court-circuitent la chaîne hiérarchique.

## Contenu problématique [00:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h00m20s)
- L'affaire éclaire une fois de plus les mécanismes de manipulation de l'information de notre époque et éclabousse le mastodonte BFM TV.
- Cette histoire nous montre qu'il y a quelque chose de pourri dans le système médiatique.

## Article du site spécialisé [01:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h01m45s)
- Un article du site spécialisé Politique a été publié le 2 février dernier et mentionne la mise à l'écart du journaliste Rachid Mbarki.
- L'article suspecte des opérations d'influence de régimes autoritaires et explique timidement que c'est en interne que ces soupçons ont été évoqués.

## Illustration de l'article [02:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h02m07s)
- Une illustration de l'article est une brève sur le Forum économique Espagnol organisé à Dakhla au Maroc. 
- Ce sujet paraît trop pointu pour ne pas être promotionnel et mentionne le Sahara Marocain, ce qui n'est pas reconnu du point de vue droit international.

## Réchauffement des relations entre le Maroc et l'Espagne [02:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h02m38s)
- Ce Forum économique est rendu possible par le réchauffement des relations diplomatiques entre le Maroc et l'Espagne, avec la reconnaissance officielle par l'Espagne du Sahara Marocain.
- 250 acteurs économiques et financiers espagnols sont réunis pour investir dans de nombreux domaines tels que l'industrie, les technologies et le tourisme.
## Désinformation israélienne [04:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h04m10s)
- Une société de désinformation israélienne a fourni des brèves pour l'ONG Forbidden Stories.
- Cette société de désinformation a été commandée par des clients et transmise sur les réseaux sociaux, tels que Twitter et Facebook.

## Intermédiaire français [04:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h04m34s)
- Un intermédiaire français a activé un journaliste de BFM TV pour diffuser des contenus douteux.
- Ces contenus ont été envoyés à BFM TV par ce journaliste.

## BFM TV victime ou complice ? [04:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h04m49s)
- Selon Marc-Olivier Fogiel, le patron de BFM TV, cette chaîne n'est rien d'autre qu'une victime de cette affaire.
- Cependant, certains s'interrogent sur la façon dont un média de cette ampleur a pu être le réceptacle de ces opérations d'influence.
- Il semble que BFM TV n'ait pas pris le temps de vérifier les brèves qui leur étaient fournies, et qui se sont révélées problématiques.

## Anomalies [05:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h05m17s)
- Il y a eu des anomalies dans la chaîne hiérarchique de BFM TV, ce qui pose problème.
- Les images étaient demandées en dernière minute, une fois que le rédacteur en chef avait validé l'ensemble du journal.

## Est-ce trop facile ? [05:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h05m57s)
- Certains, dont le journaliste de Libération Vincent Caucase, se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport à l'explication de Marc-Olivier Fogiel.
- Est-ce que ce n'est pas un peu trop facile ?
## Dysfonctionnement des rédactions [06:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h06m58s)
- Rosa Moussaoui, journaliste à l'Humanité, évoque une sorte d'habituation aux opérations d'influence diverses et variées. 
- La porosité des rédactions et la façon dont on fabrique l'information aujourd'hui sont mises en jeu. 
- Les pressions extérieures des entreprises, des responsables politiques et des institutions sont aussi impliquées. 

## Vincent Hervouet et le scandale [08:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h08m42s)
- Vincent Hervouet est connu comme étant chroniqueur international sur Europe 1 qui n'hésite pas à se saisir de sujets concernant le Maroc. 
- En farfouillant un peu le web, un article du quotidien La Provence a été trouvé, qui relève une des opérations qui lui sont reprochées : accompagner au profit de Port-Sec SA, une entreprise basée au Panama liée à des intérêts israéliens. 
- La seule différence entre cette brève et celle de BFM est une minuscule mention "Contenu Sponsorisé" écrite en dessous du titre de l'article. 

## Brande compte et influence [09:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h09m48s)
- Le "Brande Compte", ou publicité qui cherche à tromper le lecteur, l'auditeur ou le spectateur en se faisant passer pour du rédactionnel, ne cesse de coloniser nos écrans et colonnes. 
- Une opération d'influence n'est-elle pas problématique quand elle concerne des puissances étrangères ? 
- En novembre 2016, l'homme de l'ombre Sulfurié Attaquedine a fait de très graves révélations au sujet de Nicolas Sarkozy à propos des supposés financements libyens de sa campagne 2007.
## Où avait été diffusé ces images de rétractation? [11:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h11m03s)
- Les images de la rétractation de Rachid M'Barki avaient été diffusées sur BFM TV.

## Qui en était à l'origine? [11:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h11m06s)
- Aucun journaliste de BFM TV n'était à l'origine des images. Fabrice Mediapart a révélé que cette réaction de Ziathakedin était le résultat de tractations étranges, y compris financières.

## Qui était le personnage central et soupçonné d'avoir participé à tout ça? [11:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h11m22s)
- Le personnage central et soupçonné d'avoir participé à tout ça était Michel Marchand, surnommé "Mimi".

## Quelle était la spécialité de Mimi? [11:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h11m28s)
- Mimi était connue pour être la "Papesse de la presse people". Elle gérait l'image du couple Macron, et avait des entrées à l'Élysée, à la Maison du Touquet et à la Rotonde.

## Qui était le photographe qui a capturé la rétractation de Ziathakedin? [12:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h12m02s)
- Le photographe qui a capturé la rétractation de Ziathakedin était Sébastien Valliella, un des principaux photographes de Mimi Marchand.

## Quelle était la relation entre Mimi et le couple Macron? [12:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktgoio4SgCI&t=00h12m19s)
- Mimi était très proche du couple Macron, et avait également des liens avec le couple Bruni-Sarkozy.

# Biggest SaaS Opportunity in 2023: ChatGPT API

## Introduction 
- OpenAI has introduced an API that provides access to the AI model used by ChatGPT.
- This allows integration of ChatGPT into other products or building entirely new products on top of it.
- This is considered the biggest SaaS opportunity in 2023.

## Benefits of ChatGPT API 
- ChatGPT is an invention from OpenAI, trained to assist through a chat interface.
- It can help answer a wide range of questions and have whole conversations on almost any topic.
- API (Application Programming Interface) is a way for different software applications to communicate with each other over the internet.
- ChatGPT API enables developers to ask the ChatGPT model for an output without having to access the ChatGPT website and using their interface.
- Developers can display the output on their own products and give their users an incredible experience.

## No-code Integration 
- No-code integration means you don't have to be a hardcore software engineer to integrate ChatGPT API.
- The barrier isn't high, and it's affordable.
- Developers can combine ChatGPT API with no-code tools like webflow, framer, or frameworks like Reactor View.

## ChatGPT and AI Writing Assistant 
- Feed Hive is a social media marketing tool that added an AI writing assistant to their product.
- This AI assistant can come up with ideas for a post on a specific topic, suggest improvements, and help with specific parts of the post.
- The AI writing assistant is integrated into the product, and users don't have to leave the page or switch browser tabs.

## Creating a Unique Experience 
- The AI writing assistant feels different from the regular ChatGPT.
- It will politely reject helping things that are not related to social media and will reply in ways specific to creating content.
- Developers can set up specific guidelines for the model to follow.
- This enables developers to create a totally unique experience for users, an experience that's worth paying for.

## Behind the Scenes 
- OpenAI has another platform where developers can access their playground.
- Developers can pick the model, tweak behavior, and set up a chat conversation just like they would see it in ChatGPT.
- Developers can prepare the model with initial instructions and guidelines.
- Developers can give the model a long list of super-specific guidelines to follow.
- When developers have prepared their chatbot, they can click the view code button and get the code to interact with the API.

## Creating ChatGPT for X 
- Developers can create a ChatGPT for X based on their expertise to make it specialized in very specific knowledge areas.
- For example, an accountant can create an account and GPT, a musician can create music GPT, and an advertiser can create ad GPT.

# Face à OMAR SY.

## Reasons why it was important to make this film [00:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h00m09s)
- It was important for Omar Sy to make this film in order to bring the story of the African Tirailleurs to light. 
- This story is too often overlooked, and it was important for Omar Sy to bring a sense of balance to this by making this film.
- Mathieu, the director, had the idea for this film about 10 years ago, on the set of Intouchables. 

## The importance of raising awareness [00:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h00m25s)
- Omar Sy felt it was important to raise awareness of the Tirailleurs, as the story of their sacrifices is too often overlooked. 
- He and Mathieu discussed the idea for the film, and it was important for Omar Sy to have the information to answer the questions of why and how this film was being made. 
- The link between the Tirailleurs and the Poilus needs to be highlighted, as they both fought in the same war and under the same conditions. 
- The hope is that this film will be a start in getting this story out there, and will bring their sacrifices to light. 

## Why is this the first French film of this kind? [01:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h01m34s)
- It is difficult to answer this question, as it is hard to obtain information on the Tirailleurs. 
- Omar Sy hopes that this film will be the start in bringing their story to light, and will bring them to the same level of recognition as the Poilus. 
- He also hopes that the film will symbolize all of the soldiers who fought in the war, and will be paid homage on November 11th.
## The need for action [03:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h03m06s)
- Don't just ask why, but focus on finding a way to take action.
- The film is both a response and a questioning of the uncomfortable situation.
- The war is a trauma and a source of suffering.

## Silence of the Tirailleurs [03:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h03m32s)
- Sometimes things that are too painful are left unsaid.
- The children of the Tirailleurs have the need to talk about their history, as they now live in France.
- A connection between France and the home countries needs to be established.

## New forms of storytelling [04:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h04m51s)
- Young authors, actors and directors are now creating stories that tell this history.
- These stories are necessary as they were not told before.
- A movie such as this can also be educational, helping the new generation learn more about this history.
## Incarner un personnage qui parle sa langue maternelle [06:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h06m50s)
- Omar Sy parle sa langue maternelle, le peul, dans le film. 
- C’était tout à fait naturel pour lui et correspondait bien à l’histoire qu’il racontait. 
- Incarner un personnage et parler sa langue maternelle a permis à Omar Sy d’explorer des zones qu’il n’aurait pas pu atteindre avec le français.

## Rôle de père protecteur [08:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h08m09s)
- Omar Sy incarne un père qui décide de rejoindre les forces françaises pour retrouver son fils qui a été enrôlé de force. 
- Dans la vraie vie, Omar Sy est un père de 5 enfants, ce qui lui a donné une plus grande compréhension du rôle protecteur qu’il interprète.
- Incarner ce rôle a révélé un peu de son intimité qui était cachée, ce qui lui a permis d’explorer des zones qu’il n’aurait pas pu atteindre autrement.
## Communication interdiction [08:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h08m17s)
- Omar Sy explique que sa façon de comprendre ses personnages vient de lui-même mais qu'il ne sait pas à quel point cela se connecte à lui.
- Il mentionne que sa façon de communiquer avec son père est par le dialogue des mains.

## Introspection [08:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h08m50s)
- Omar Sy a déclaré que le film a été une grande introspection pour lui.

## Protection des enfants [09:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h09m24s)
- Omar Sy a déclaré qu'il a du mal à donner des conseils car ils sont basés sur la peur et l'expérience des gens.
- Il a expliqué que chaque enfant est différent et ce qui fonctionne pour l'un ne fonctionne pas forcément pour l'autre.
- Son conseil : écouter vraiment ses enfants.
## Question to close [11:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h11m03s)
- Omar Sy is asked to give advice to the young generation on how to feel good in France, in light of the multiculturalism that is present. 

## Offering advice [11:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h11m26s)
- Omar Sy encourages the young generation to express themselves, and to take part in the construction of France's future. 
- He urges them not to fear change, and to embrace the newness brought by this generation. 

## Expressing appreciation [13:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h13m28s)
- Omar Sy expresses gratitude to the Senegalese people for their life and sacrifices, and appreciates how this makes him feel more legitimate in France. 

## Final question [13:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h13m20s)
- If Omar Sy could speak to the last Senegalese tirailleur, who passed away in 1998, what would he say to them? 
- Omar Sy would thank them for their life and sacrifices.
## Definition of engagement [14:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h14m18s)
- Omar Sy defines engagement as a sensibility, and feels that true engagement is something that is no longer seen today.
- He cites the examples of Coluche and Balavoine who he feels were true artists who were genuinely engaged.
- For Omar Sy, engagement is not about saying a lot, but rather about having the capability to open up and express what you feel.

## Appreciation [15:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjNAGR9NlCU&t=00h15m23s)
- Crazy Sally expresses appreciation for Omar Sy's participation in the film and how it was exceptional.
- She thanks him for his answer to the questions.
